card.title: How To Fix An iPhone 13 with No Audio No Vibration and Slow Camera Response

source.title: How To Fix An iPhone 13 with No Audio No Vibration and Slow Camera Response

claims.statement: iPhone 13 with no bottom speaker, no Taptic vibration and a laggy camera app, unchanged by known-good parts or a restore, is commonly a failing U8400 IC.

procedure: Inspect U8400 for cracks, burns or impact marks.
Test known-good speaker and Taptic Engine.
Replace U8400 (flux, gentle heat, clean pads, reball, align by boardview).
Test ringer, vibration, camera and haptics.
card.caveats: Source does not state U8400's function; based on field reports. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
